Transport Documents

Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature

A document recording the transfer of containers or equipment between parties (e.g., carrier, terminal, trucker) detailing condition and responsibility at interchange.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature?

In this glossary, Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature refers to: A document recording the transfer of containers or equipment between parties (e.g., carrier, terminal, trucker) detailing condition and responsibility at interchange.

How is Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "L’autista ha firmato il documento di intercambio attrezzature al ritiro del contenitore vuoto dal terminal."

Why does Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature matter in logistics?

Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature?

Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature belong to?

In this glossary, Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A document recording the transfer of containers or equipment between parties (e.g., carrier, terminal, trucker) detailing condition and responsibility at interchange.

Operational example

The trucker signed the equipment interchange upon taking custody of the empty container from the terminal.

Localized term

Documento di Intercambio Attrezzature

Localized example

L’autista ha firmato il documento di intercambio attrezzature al ritiro del contenitore vuoto dal terminal.
